title: 旅行提案编辑器
prompt: 把这些想去的地方整理成一份能发给朋友的旅行提案，我想修改封面和说明。
program:
root = Col([introText, tool, usageNote])

$coverTitle = "去山里过个周末"
$coverSubtitle = "2天1晚 · 建德 / 桐庐"
$intro = "这是一份示例提案：日期、预算和行程都可以改，不是预订确认。我们先去梅城慢走，再坐船看富春江，最后在桐庐喝茶收尾。"
$coverStyle = "山野"

introText = Text("把想去的地方整理成一份旅行提案。下面直接修改封面标题、副标题和说明，预览会实时更新；想发给朋友时点复制，行程部分为示例数据，未发生任何预订。")

coverImageQuery = $coverStyle == "山野" ? "Mountain tea fields Hangzhou" : ($coverStyle == "海边" ? "coastal walking path" : "city skyline at dusk")
coverBg = $coverStyle == "山野" ? "#2F4F3A" : ($coverStyle == "海边" ? "#0C4A6E" : "#3F3F46")

coverPreview = Box([SearchImage(coverImageQuery, 1.4), Col([Title($coverTitle, "lg", "white"), Text($coverSubtitle, "sm", "white", "medium")], 2)], "col", 3, 3, coverBg, "lg")

editControls = Col([
  Row([Input($coverTitle, "封面标题"), Input($coverSubtitle, "封面副标题")], 2),
  Label("封面风格"),
  SegmentedControl($coverStyle, ["山野", "海边", "城市"], true),
  TextArea($intro, "说明文字", "给朋友的话", 3)
], 3)

destLines = @Each(destinations, "d", "Day " + d.day + " · " + d.title + " — " + d.note)

summaryText = $coverTitle + "\n" + $coverSubtitle + "\n\n" + $intro + "\n\n想去的地方：\n" + @Join(destLines, "\n")

placeRows = Col(@Each(destinations, "d", TravelItem(d.title, d.note, [SearchImage(d.image, 1.4)], [Badge("第 " + d.day + " 天", "purple")])), 3)

destinationList = Col([
  Row([Title("想去的地方", "md"), Badge("示例数据", "neutral")], 2),
  placeRows
], 3)

copyBtn = Button("复制提案文字", @CopyToClipboard(summaryText), "solid", "primary", "md", "copy")
resetBtn = Button("恢复示例", @Reset($coverTitle, $coverSubtitle, $intro, $coverStyle), "soft", "primary", "md", "rotate-ccw")

tool = TravelModule([
  coverPreview,
  editControls,
  Divider(),
  destinationList
], "itinerary", "给朋友的旅行提案", "示例数据 · 未预订", [copyBtn, resetBtn])

usageNote = Text("小提示：把复制出的文字发在聊天里，朋友可以直接看到封面和每一天的安排。这里不会创建订单，也不包含真实价格。")

destinations = [
  {day: 1, title: "梅城古镇", note: "沿江慢走，吃建德豆腐包", image: "Yanzhou ancient town Jiande"},
  {day: 2, title: "七里扬帆", note: "坐船看富春江两岸青山", image: "Fuchun River Qili Yangfan"},
  {day: 3, title: "桐庐慢生活", note: "河边喝茶，傍晚回程", image: "Luci village Tonglu"}
]
